  def route_safe($value): ($value | gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]"; "-"));
  def route_prefix($group_type):
    if $group_type == "top_level" then "top-level"

    else $group_type
    end;
  def recommended_strategy($lane):
    if $lane == "hepta-systems" then "hepta_systems_owned_batch_review"

    elif $lane == "mixed" or $lane == "mixed-hepta-and-cross-lane" then "split_owned_and_cross_lane_review"
    else "operator_classification_required"
    end;
  def operator_action($lane):
    if $lane == "hepta-systems" then "prepare_hepta_systems_clean_plan_for_operator_review"
    elif $lane == "cross-lane-review" or $lane == "external-or-cross-lane" then "request_owner_classification_before_cleanup"
    elif $lane == "mixed" or $lane == "mixed-hepta-and-cross-lane" then "split_group_into_owned_and_cross_lane_subsets"
    else "classify_group_before_any_cleanup"
    end;
  def strategy_entry:
    . as $entry
    | {
      source_readback_key:$entry.readback_key,
      source_readback_route:$entry.readback_route,
      source_diff_key:$entry.diff_key,
      strategy_key:("dirty_worktree.strategy." + $entry.group_type + "." + key_safe($entry.source_bucket)),

      review_lane:$entry.review_lane,
      recommended_strategy:recommended_strategy($entry.review_lane),
      operator_action:operator_action($entry.review_lane),
      evidence_requirement:"clean_worktree_decision_record_required_before_release",
      execution_mode:"strategy_only_no_git_mutation",

      evidence_recording_allowed:false,
      release_cutover_allowed:false,
      live_execution_allowed:false

  ($readback.entries | map(strategy_entry)) as $entries |
  ($entries | length) as $strategy_entry_count |

  ($entries | map(select(.evidence_recording_allowed == true)) | length) as $evidence_recorded_count |
  ($readback.operator_readback_ready == true

      else "adapter_projection_shape"
      end;
  def redaction_policy($source):
      if $source == "update_plan_tool" or $source == "plan_mode_proposed_plan_blocks" then "hash proposed plan text and expose only trace, step, node, and evidence refs"
      elif $source == "app_server_turn_plan_notification" then "hash notification payload and expose only trace, turn, and notification refs"
      elif $source == "multi_agent_v2_mailbox_wait" then "hash mailbox content and expose only trace, agent path, mailbox seq, and delivery refs"
      elif $source == "hepta_runtime_multi_agent_reducer" then "hash subagent output and expose only task result status, reducer strategy, and evidence refs"
      elif $source == "hepta_runtime_task_board" then "hash worker commands and artifacts; expose only lane, lease, status, and artifact refs"
      elif $source == "hepta_runtime_approval_broker" then "hash approval payload and expose only approver role, decision state, and evidence refs"
      else "hash raw payloads and expose only redacted evidence refs"
      end;
  def plan($action): {
      closure_action_id: $action.id,
      source_surface_id: $action.source_surface_id,
      adapter_kind: $action.adapter_kind,
      readback_scope: readback_scope($action.adapter_kind),

      expected_timeline_event_type_ids: $action.timeline_event_type_ids,

      performs_readback: false,
      mutates_runtime: false

      closure_action_id: $action.id,
      source_surface_id: $action.source_surface_id,
      required_fixture_fields: $action.required_evidence_fields,
      expected_fixture_state: "fixture_shape_defined_runtime_not_attached",
      redaction_policy: redaction_policy($action.source_surface_id),
      performs_readback: false,

  def store_assertion($action): {
      closure_action_id: $action.id,
      source_surface_id: $action.source_surface_id,
      projected_collection_ids: $action.projected_collection_ids,
      required_evidence_fields: $action.required_evidence_fields,
      idempotency_guard_required: true,
      expected_projection_state: "store_projection_shape_defined_store_write_disabled",
      performs_readback: false,
      mutates_store: false

  def timeline_assertion($action): {
      closure_action_id: $action.id,
      source_surface_id: $action.source_surface_id,
      timeline_event_type_ids: $action.timeline_event_type_ids,
      required_evidence_fields: $action.required_evidence_fields,

      expected_event_state: "timeline_event_shape_defined_timeline_persistence_disabled",
      performs_readback: false,
      persists_timeline: false
    };
  def drift($id; $fields; $severity): {
      id: $id,
      compared_field_ids: $fields,
      severity: $severity,
      blocks_closure_application: true,
      performs_readback: false
    };
  def blocker($id; $severity; $affected; $fix): {
      id: $id,
      severity: $severity,
      affected_closure_action_ids: $affected,
      required_before_projection_enforcement: true,
      recommended_fix: $fix

      drift("detect_timeline_event_type_drift"; ["timeline_event_type_ids", "eventKind", "evidenceRefs"]; "critical"),
      drift("detect_fixture_redaction_drift"; ["fixtureHash", "redactionState", "sourceSurfaceId"]; "high"),

      blocker("post_readback_enforcement_readiness_not_rerun"; "medium"; ($closure.closure_actions | map(.id)); "rerun unified projection enforcement-readiness after readback and application previews agree")
    ] as $blockers
  | {

      runtime: "hepta",
      status: "ready",
      gate: "hepta_work_graph_projection_adapter_gap_closure_readback_preview_gate",
      schema_version: "work_graph_projection_adapter_gap_closure_readback_preview_v1",

      timeline_event_type_reference_count: (($timeline_assertions | map(.timeline_event_type_ids | length) | add) // 0),
      drift_detector_count: ($drift_detectors | length),
      blocker_count: ($blockers | length),
      required_prior_gate_count: (($closure.required_prior_gates + [$closure.gate]) | length),
      readback_plans: $readback_plans,
      fixture_readback_assertions: $fixture_assertions,
      store_readback_assertions: $store_assertions,
      timeline_readback_assertions: $timeline_assertions,
      drift_detectors: $drift_detectors,
      blockers: $blockers,

      recommended_next_gate: "hepta_work_graph_projection_adapter_gap_closure_application_preview_gate",

          upstream_gate: ($closure.gate == "hepta_work_graph_projection_adapter_gap_closure_preview_gate")
